MOVING THE MACHINE
This machine is fitted with castors to make it easier to move. Take care when moving the machine on an inclined surface.
The Header Assembly has a forward centre of gravity, so it is important that at least two people are used to fit or remove the Header Assembly.
The fitting position of the Header Assembly is high, and it is important that a means of reaching the height safely,without stretching, is available. (e.g. Steps, Step Stool etc.) > & BP B-
The overall height of the machine, with the Header Assembly fitted, is 280mm. Take care of any overhead obstructions. (e.g. Light Fittings, Electric Cables etc.)

danger.

2. HOW TO PLAY
This is a horse riding game in which up to four players, (if two machines are linked), are the jockeys. Players can choose from three tracks and six horses.
Method of Play

The player straddles the horse, crouching (not sitting) with their feet on the footrests, and rocks the horse backwards and forwards. The speed of the horse is controlled by the speed of the rocking motion. If the player presses the whip button on the rein handle while rocking the horse rapidly, the horse will accelerate quickly or continue to run at maximum speed. To maintain the horse’s stamina up to the finish, the player must not make the horse run too fast during the first half of the race. As the leading horse enters the final 600 metres, game points are displayed and a fanfare sounded, signalling the final sprint. As the scramble for game points begins, the players press their whip button, while rapidly rocking their horses in the final sprint.
Game Rules

The object of the game is to be first past the winning post. The horse has a limited amount of stamina and slows down as this is used up. Stamina is used up quickly if the horse is made to run too fast too early or is made to accelerate quickly. Unlike in real horse racing, there are no penalties for obstruction, and bumping into other horses is permitted. If a horse fails to reach the winning post within three seconds of the winning horse, it is disqualified.
Races.
The following three types of race are available, differing from one another in terms of distance and track layout.
1. Straight Stakes (1200 metres)
2. Royal Garden Cup (1600 metres)
3. Turf Grand Prix (2400 metres)

The track to be played is the track selected by the most players prior to the start of the game. If there is equal choice for Straight Stakes and Royal Garden Stakes the game will choose at random, if there is equal choice for Turf Grand Prix and another track, the shorter track will be selected.
